speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly what happened right before you lost consciousness, and did you experience any warning signs like dizziness or chest pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I was just finishing urinating when I suddenly blacked out and fell to the floor. I didn't feel any dizziness, chest pain, or warning signs before it happened. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the sudden loss of consciousness immediately following urination, this is highly suggestive of micturition syncope, a form of situational syncope caused by a vasovagal response. DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope
